title: Goiás Esporte Clube
description: Brazilian association football club based in Goiânia, Goiás, Brazil
extract: Goiás Esporte Clube is a Brazilian football club based in Goiânia, Goiás. It competes in the Campeonato Goiano, the Goiás highest level state league, and in the Campeonato Brasileiro Série B, the second tier of Brazilian league system. The club plays its home matches at Estádio da Serrinha for 14,450 spectators, and occasionally at Estádio Serra Dourada for 42,049 spectators.
